It has a very elaborate system for marking inalienability,{{citation |author=Anvita Abbi |title=Endangered Languages of the Andaman Islands |date=2006 |work=LINCOM Studies in Asian Linguistics, 64.) München}} with seven possessive markers reflecting different body-divisions.
